result:
Comments, deleting, reporting and auto-hiding are in place. `bun run typecheck`, `bun test` (8 tests, including 6 new ones) and the full `bunx guren gate` all pass. I didn't boot the app, so the post page's comment UI hasn't been tried in a browser. The tests only check the props it receives.

**Storage.** `db/schema.ts` now has a `comments` table and a `comment_reports` table, with migration `db/migrations/20260925024033_add_comments`. `comment_reports` has a unique index on (`comment_id`, `user_id`), so one person can only report a comment once. The foreign keys are set to cascade on delete.

**Endpoints** (`app/Http/Controllers/CommentController.ts`, wired in `routes/web.ts` behind the existing login guard):
- **`POST /posts/:id/comments`** checks the body with the same kind of rule as a post title: 1–2000 characters after trimming spaces. A comment of only spaces is therefore rejected. On success it stores the comment with the signed-in user as author and redirects to `/posts/:id`.
- **`DELETE /comments/:id`** is allowed only for the comment's author or the post's author, through a new `CommentPolicy`. Anyone else gets 403 and the comment stays. On success the row is removed and the user is sent back to the post.
- **`POST /comments/:id/report`** answers 204 every time. A repeat report by the same user adds no second row. For a comment ID that doesn't exist it returns 404 rather than 204.

**Post page.** `GET /posts/:id` now also sends a `comments` prop: oldest first, each with `{ id, body, author: { id, name }, createdAt }`, and with any comment reported by 3 or more different users left out. The `post` prop is unchanged. `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx` shows the list, a comment box when signed in (a sign-in link otherwise), Delete where the viewer is allowed, and Report.

**Deleting a post.** `PostController.destroy` now deletes the post's comments and their reports itself before deleting the post. I didn't rely only on the database cascade, because SQLite ignores foreign keys unless they are switched on.

The new tests are in `tests/CommentController.test.ts` and cover each point the acceptance run will check.
